faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for Govind Ballabh Pant Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education & Research (GIPMER), a prestigious government institution in Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for which GIPMER is recruiting?
faq.answer: GIPMER is recruiting for the post of Senior Resident on an ad-hoc basis, offering a valuable opportunity for medical professionals.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available for the Senior Resident post in this GIPMER recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for GIPMER Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Senior Resident posts is offline. Candidates need to download and submit the application form by post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application form for these posts?
faq.answer: The last date for candidates to submit their completed application forms for the Senior Resident posts is 17 August 2026.

faq.question: Q6. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for the Senior Resident positions?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Resident positions at GIPMER is scheduled to be held on 19 August 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit to apply for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants for the Senior Resident post is 45 years, with age relaxation applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q8. What are the essential qualifications required for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an MBBS with a P.G Degree or Diploma in the concerned specialty from a Recognized University/Institution and be registered with the Delhi Medical Council.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident position at GIPMER?
faq.answer: The salary for the Senior Resident position is Rs 67,700/- per month, along with usual allowances as per government norms.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of Govind Ballabh Pant Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education & Research?
faq.answer: The official website for Govind Ballabh Pant Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education & Research (GIPMER) is www.gbpant.delhigovt.nic.in.
